surface: Testing infrastructure / audit-key native retry instrumentation
title: Audit retry runner reads fault counters after deleting their owner
severity: S2: runner aborts before new case verdicts; product failure not established
preconditions: Import frozen CI artifact 11516342905 from source 52487361 (v0.2.391).
Run audit-key native acceptance under the later c93eca2 checkout.
reproduction: Compare passing checkout 94d1eeae with failing checkout c93eca2 at the T86 details retry.
The later runner calls restore(panel), which deletes window.__auditNativeFault, then reads (await fault(panel)).activeWrites after the recovered card and storage comparison.
The native receipt stops at details_failure/compare_storage_after_retry, with a recovered card, zero receipts, and fault=null. No T27/T61/T62 case result was reached.
expected: Keep write instrumentation active throughout the retry, prove storage/key history unchanged and zero active-key writes, then restore browser APIs.
actual: The post-restore fault-counter dereference throws at the runner boundary. The receipt cannot distinguish this harness failure from a storage comparison failure by its bounded code alone.
root_cause: An activeWrites assertion was added after restore(panel) had already deleted the fault object; the prior successful checkout did not contain that assertion.

transition_history.reason: Run 37703766572 stopped in details_failure before inventory-case recording.
Passing/failing checkout diff and null fault diagnostic isolate a runner object-lifetime error, not a product verdict.
Narrow source repair drafted; resource guard refused local tests with RESOURCE_DISK_LOW.

closure_requirement: Resource-admitted focused RED/GREEN and mutation tests, independent source review, then one resource-valid native original-boundary retest; T86 direct rotate invocation and T27/T61/T62 require separate case judgments.
next_action: Restore resource admission without weakening policy, run focused tests, review source, and retest native runner before changing inventory statuses.
